title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: edhoc.rs test vectors lacking independent oracle
description:
## Issue

In `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs`, the `rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors` test had broken KDF invocations (wrong arg count/types, e.g. `edhoc_kdf(&prk_2e, 7, &th_4, 32)` would not compile). This commit fixes the KDF call patterns but also updates ALL expected output vectors (keystream_2, th_3, th_4, prk_out, prk_exporter, exporter sub-derivations).

### Problem

The test is named after RFC 9529, implying the vectors should be independently verifiable against the RFC. The commit changes the expected vectors but provides no evidence they were verified against the RFC specification — they appear to have been generated by running the fixed KDF code itself.

### Rule Violation

Per AGENTS.md test vector discipline: "Never derive test vectors from the code under test."

### Expected

- Confirm the new test vectors match RFC 9529 Appendix C.3 exactly
- Document the verification method (e.g., "verified against RFC 9529 §C.3")
- If these are custom vectors, rename the test to indicate they are not from the RFC
